    YOUR HUB, CLOSE AT HAND

    Make space for possibility.

    Install VELORA–WORKBRIDGE for a dedicated app window on your phone or desktop.

    iPhone or iPad

    Open in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

    Android

    Open in Chrome, then use the menu’s Install app or Add to Home screen.

    Windows or Mac

    Open in Chrome or Edge and select the install icon in the address bar. In supported Safari versions, choose File → Add to Dock.

    Installation depends on your browser. The hub can open offline after your first visit; service portals need internet access.

    2. Continue in your portal.

      Bookings, applications, accounts and payments are handled by the linked service.

    3. Keep your next step here.

      Your checklist is a personal reminder on this device. It does not sync with Zite or verify application progress.
